name: – Rasa Juknevičienė – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's government has turned away from democracy and the European Union. It asks the EU to sanction Bidzina Ivanishvili, the man it says controls the country, and other officials. It wants all political prisoners freed, including former president Mikheil Saakashvili. It calls for laws restricting civil society and media to be repealed. It also asks the EU to keep supporting ordinary Georgians, most of whom still want to join the EU. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the EU and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's leaders, officials, judges and media owners named in the text.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide on sanctions and other measures; the Parliament cannot do it alone.
